title: Sky Runner
rules: A collision or falling ends the run. Pauses do not extend the timer. Match results wait for an opponent.
manual:
# Controls
- **Left / Right:** switch lanes.
- **Space / Up:** jump.
- **Touch:** swipe to change lanes, tap or swipe up to jump.

![Sky Runner track](assets/tutorial-scene.png)
description: Run along a floating skyway, jump over barriers, and collect glowing crystals.
goal: Cover the most distance and collect crystals. Jump over obstacles and stay on the platform.

tutorial.text: Use the left and right arrows to change lanes. Press Space or Arrow Up to jump.
On a phone, swipe left or right to change lanes and swipe up or tap to jump.
Collect crystals for extra points. A collision or a fall ends your run.
